description: DEPRECATED, prefer get_miners, which adds silver and copper. Kept working forever for clients already bound to this name: the gold-only slice of the same ranked EU-UCITS and US miner-ETF shortlists.

include_notes.description: Include the per-row prose (whenToChoose, caveat, contrast, availability, venue, entryCost) and the traps list. Default false — static copy; describe_dataset carries it.

include_series.description: Include each row's 60-point price sparkline. Default false — fourteen series is most of the payload's bytes.

market.description: Narrow to one market: 'eu' (EUR UCITS lines, buyable by EU retail) or 'us' (US-domiciled, reference only). Omit for both.

name: get_gold_miners
